metadata.name: Generic variation analysis reporting (release v0.1.1)
annotations: This workflow takes a VCF dataset of variants produced by any of the variant calling workflows in https://github.com/galaxyproject/iwc/tree/main/workflows/sars-cov-2-variant-calling and generates tabular lists of variants by Samples and by Variant, and an overview plot of variants and their allele-frequencies.
